title: Restore full EPP browser shell before workbook polish
decision: The next build slice should restore the full EPP browser shell and navigation before continuing deeper HVA workbook UI polish.
context: The current React app still uses the seed document list, so Appendix A is not visible as a normal document even though the full EPP workspace and HVA workbook sidecar state are present.
rationale: The user needs the familiar old EPP document-first browser experience back before workbook-specific UI can be evaluated in context. Appendix A should first be reachable through the Appendices group like any other appendix, with the workbook affordance attached to that document.
alternatives_considered: Continue polishing the HVA workbook inspector before full document navigation exists
Keep the seed reader as the main UI while adding direct workbook routes
Use the old generated HTML directly instead of porting the browser shell
consequences: SG-0013 is ready to build next
The seed workspace remains a fixture, not the user-facing EPP experience
Appendix A visibility becomes the first user-facing acceptance gate
SG-0014 remains the follow-on slice for deeper Markdown rendering and editing parity
